raster_policy.rule: Every generation starts at raster 1. Any technical failure in a later raster returns to raster 1 after a whitelisted repair before work may continue.

ordered_rasters.purpose: Verify executables, dependencies, public data, configs, checkpoints, safety boundaries and validator health before any research work.
Generate and optimize challenger hypotheses using training data only.
Backtest and score repeatable target hits, returns and trade evidence.
Reject incomplete, failed, cherry-picked or statistically fragile validation evidence.
Apply drawdown and near-ruin risk gates with veto authority.
Promote only a superior non-vetoed challenger, checkpoint state, then start the next generation at raster 1.

supervisor.name: TenDaySupervisor
supervisor.role: Research manager and sole promotion authority

research_agent.name: ResearchAgent
research_agent.role: Generate challenger parameter hypotheses through deterministic Hyperopt search using training data only

operations_agent.name: OpsWatchdog
operations_agent.role: Raster 1 gate: continuously verify research health, executables, dependencies, public data, configs, validator smoke tests, checkpoints and stalled or failed runs without influencing strategy scores

agents.name: QuantAgent
agents.role: Reward repeatable target hits and median return without using blind holdout data

agents.name: ValidationCritic
agents.role: Reject incomplete, failed, cherry-picked or statistically fragile validation results

agents.name: RiskAgent
agents.role: Penalize drawdown and near-ruin behavior and veto unacceptable capital-risk profiles

promotion.rule: No veto AND council score strictly exceeds current champion score
